_doc: Pinned P0 pass criteria for the four-persona journey (handoff DEEPSEEK_AGY_CLAUDE_REAL_USER_QA_20261114, Gate 4/5). The Test Director (AGY) and any model may not edit this file; it is hash-pinned.
verdictRule: A scenario is PASS only with screenshot + sanitized trace + console log + its oracle checks passing (oracle --set p0). Missing evidence = NOT RUN. Any 'Maximum update depth exceeded' / React error #185 in logs/console.jsonl = FAIL for P0-02. 'Recovers after reload' is not a pass. Oracle results count only from live pg mode (oracle.cjs refuses snapshot mode for --set p0). Browser-only items (UI 'historical' badge, key-by-key typing, receiver view, 10 upload cycles, AI answer) are judged by the independent auditor from screenshots + sanitized trace + console.jsonl; an operator's self-report alone is NOT RUN.

scenarios.title: Renamed upload Rev0 -> Rev1 (-> Rev2) stays one file lineage
browser: A1 uploads fixture rev0 via composer
A2 uploads fixture rev1 via the Rev0 card's version action (upload_fixture target=version)
B2 uploads fixture rev2 via the Rev1 card's version action
UI shows one file card with versions 1..3, not separate files

scenarios.title: Approval semantics: old approval is history only; new version starts unconfirmed
browser: A2 and B1 confirm Rev0 for their own organisations
after Rev1, Rev0 approval shown as historical/superseded, not current
double-click on request review creates one request

scenarios.title: No React #185 during uploads
browser: preview and panel buttons still operable after each upload
logs/console.jsonl contains no 'Maximum update depth' and no React error #185

scenarios.title: Own messages never count as own unread
browser: A1 sends, uploads and requests review: A1 sidebar unread stays 0
same after reload, room switch and fresh sign-in

scenarios.title: No first-character loss; numbers exact
browser: at least 30 messages typed key by key with press, immediately after switching room, exact text 'P0T-<n> 12mm M20 USD 1,200'

scenarios.title: AI uses the corrected value
browser: a wrong value is posted then corrected in a later message
AI summary/answer cites the corrected value and its source message

scenarios.title: Event log integrity for the P0 project

knownToolLimits: IME composition input cannot be produced by the restricted tool (press sends key events only); P0-04 IME sub-case is NOT RUN unless a reviewed tool is added
Credentials rendered as page pixels cannot be detected; mitigated by tracing only after login and browser-masked password inputs. Trace image entries are scanned and fail closed but not rewritten.
